result.summary: Found 1 major issue: the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card in the 'Popular right now' section has a missing/placeholder image.

issues.description: The 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' card shows a broken image placeholder icon instead of an actual restaurant image, while other cards on the page display proper images.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the image asset loads correctly or provide a fallback image so the placeholder icon is never shown to users.
